text:
Raat kitni hi lambi ho,
Subah apna raasta dhoond hi leti hai.
Akela pan bas ek andhera hai,
Jo nayi roshni ke aane par khud ba khud mit jaata hai.
Har naye din ke sath,
Ek nayi ummeed kadam badhati hai.
title: Nayi Subah Ki Aas
description: An uplifting status post about finding hope and warmth after a lonely night, crafted for a general Indian audience.
